youtube.title: Guru ne ek shishya ka angootha kyun maang liya? 🙏 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Nishadraj ka putra Ekalavya acharya Drona se dhanurvidya seekhna chahta tha, par Drona ne use shishya nahi banaya. Ekalavya ne jungle mein Drona ki mitti ki murti banayi aur usi ke saamne din-raat abhyas karke mahan dhanurdhar ban gaya.

Ek din Pandav aur Kauravon ka kutta jungle mein Ekalavya ke paas pahuncha. Ekalavya ne baanon se uska mukh bhar diya, bina use ghayal kiye. Arjun ne yeh dekha to Drona se kaha ki aapne mujhe sabse bada dhanurdhar banane ka vachan diya tha. Drona Ekalavya ke paas gaye aur guru dakshina mein uske daahine haath ka angootha maanga. Ekalavya ne bina jhijhak ke angootha kaat kar de diya.

Katha ka strot: Mahabharata, Adi Parva (adhyay 123).
